Name: EBAGI Style for Fallen London Mushrom Wines
Author: Tolpen
Description:
[size=4][b]Welcome, DELICIOUS FARMER![/b][/size]

Do you crave the subtle hint of cosmic horror and [size=4][b]Victorian[/b][/size] fantasy with every taste [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5647]winterykite's Fallen London Mushroom Wines[/url], yet you find yourself wishing that the fine vintages had the likeness of your fine Ancient Fruit Wine? Are you absolutely normal in keeping the mod art consistent?
Then look no further, EBAGI Style for Fallen London Mushroom Wines has you covered.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/42646015-1730024902.png[/img]
[b]What does this mod do?[/b]
It replaces the six icons used for FLMW with colour-coded SDV wine bottles.

[b]How do I install this mod?[/b]
Extract the [i]Objects[/i] file into [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\Fallen London Mushroom Wines\[JA] Fallen London Mushroom[/i] [i]Wines [/i]and when prompted, allow to [i]replace items in folder[/i].

[b]How do I uninstall this mod?[/b]
Simple re-install FLMW.

[b]Is this mod compatible with [patch] and [mod]?[/b]
This mod is compatible with any patch and mod that FLMW works with.
That said, it's been tested with SDV patch 1.5 and 1.6.13, works without any issues. It shouldn't have any conflict with mods that do [i]not [/i]put base-game mushrooms into kegs.
[b]
Does this mod add any new wines like Magma Cap Wine or (SVE) Mushroom Colony Wine?[/b]
No, this mod only replaces the original mod art and nothing else.
(Look, I can edit sprites, not write code, okay?)

[b]Does this mod rely on [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Icons[/url]?[/b]
No! You can use this mod without EBAGI
[b]
How do I tell at first glance which of my bottles are mushroom wines?[/b]
All six mushroom wines have a washed out sepia label while other EBAGI wines have a light brown label.
